title: Travel, problems & emergencies
goal: Deal with hotels, missed trains, lost things and emergencies, ask for help urgently, and use 'if… then' sentences.
intro:
Things go wrong when you travel: trains are missed, bags get lost, the AC breaks down. This unit gives you the words to explain the problem and get help — including the phrases you hope never to need.

The grammar is **conditionals**: real ones with **जर… तर…** ('if… then…'), and unreal ones like 'if I had known, I would have come'.

grammar.title: Real conditions: जर… तर…
grammar.body:
**जर** (if) + condition, **तर** (then) + result. The 'if' clause usually uses the **past** form even when talking about the future — just as English says 'if it rains' not 'if it will rain':

जर पाऊस **पडला** तर आम्ही येणार नाही 'If it rains, we won't come.'

जर is often dropped; तर is enough: वेळ मिळाला तर फोन करेन 'If I get time, I'll call.'

The present habitual also works for general truths: पाणी उकळलं तर वाफ होते.

**Formal 'if':** stem + **ल्यास**: उशीर झाल्यास कळवा 'in case of delay, inform us'.

**Otherwise:** नाहीतर: लवकर निघ, नाहीतर ट्रेन चुकेल 'Leave early, otherwise you'll miss the train.'

examples.native: जर बॅग सापडली तर मला फोन करा.
examples.roman: dzar bæg sāpaḍlī tar malā fon karā.
examples.en: If the bag is found, call me.

examples.native: तुला बरं वाटत नसेल तर डॉक्टरकडे जा.
examples.roman: tulā baraṃ vāṭat nasel tar ḍôkṭarkaḍe dzā.
examples.en: If you're not feeling well, go to the doctor.

examples.native: ट्रेन रद्द झाली तर आपण बसने जाऊ.
examples.roman: ṭren radda dzhālī tar āpaṇ basne dzāū.
examples.en: If the train is cancelled, we'll go by bus.

examples.native: काही अडचण आल्यास या नंबरवर संपर्क साधा.
examples.roman: kāhī aḍtsaṇ ālyās yā nambarvar samparka sādhā.
examples.en: In case of any difficulty, contact this number.
Keep your passport safely, otherwise it'll get lost.

grammar.title: Unreal conditions: 'If I had known…'
grammar.body:
For things that didn't happen (or can't), Marathi uses past participle + **असता / असती / असतं** ('would have'):

जर मला **माहीत असतं** तर मी **आलो असतो** 'If I had known, I would have come.'

The असता part agrees like a past verb: मी आलो असतो (m) / आले असते (f), त्याने केलं असतं (ergative, agreeing with the object). Negative: केलं **नसतं**, आलो **नसतो**.

In speech the result clause is often shortened: बरं झालं असतं 'it would have been nice'.

examples.native: जर मी लवकर निघालो असतो तर ट्रेन चुकली नसती.
examples.roman: dzar mī lavkar nighālo asto tar ṭren tsuklī nastī.
examples.en: If I had left early, I wouldn't have missed the train.

examples.native: तू सांगितलं असतंस तर मी मदत केली असती.
examples.roman: tū sāṅgitlaṃ astaṃs tar mī madat kelī astī.
examples.en: If you'd told me, I would have helped.

examples.native: पाऊस पडला नसता तर आम्ही गेलो असतो.
examples.roman: pāūs paḍlā nastā tar āmhī gelo asto.
examples.en: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone.

examples.native: माझ्याकडे पैसे असते तर मी नवीन फोन घेतला असता.
examples.roman: mājhyākaḍe paise aste tar mī navīn fon ghetlā astā.
examples.en: If I had the money, I would have bought a new phone.

dialogue.title: Checking in, minus one bag
dialogue.setting: Emma arrives at her hotel in Mumbai after a long flight — without one of her suitcases.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.native: नमस्कार, माझं बुकिंग आहे, एमा ब्राऊन नावाने.
lines.roman: namaskār, mādzhaṃ bukiṅg āhe, emā brāūn nāvāne.
lines.en: Hello, I have a booking in the name of Emma Brown.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.native: हो, मिळालं. तुमचा पासपोर्ट दाखवाल का?
lines.roman: ho, miḷālaṃ. tumtsā pāsporṭ dākhvāl kā?
lines.en: Yes, found it. Could you show me your passport?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.native: हा घ्या. आणि एक प्रॉब्लेम आहे — माझी एक बॅग विमानतळावर हरवली.
lines.roman: hā ghyā. āṇi ek prôblem āhe — mājhī ek bæg vimāntaḷāvar haravlī.
lines.en: Here you are. And there's a problem — one of my bags got lost at the airport.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.native: अरेरे! तुम्ही एअरलाइनकडे तक्रार केलीत का?
lines.roman: arere! tumhī earlāinkaḍe takrār kelīt kā?
lines.en: Oh dear! Did you file a complaint with the airline?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.native: हो. त्यांनी सांगितलं की बॅग सापडली तर ते हॉटेलवर पाठवतील.
lines.roman: ho. tyānnī sāṅgitlaṃ kī bæg sāpaḍlī tar te hôṭelvar pāṭhavtīl.
lines.en: Yes. They said if the bag is found, they'll send it to the hotel.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.native: काळजी करू नका. बॅग आली तर आम्ही लगेच तुमच्या खोलीत पाठवू.
lines.roman: kāḷjī karū nakā. bæg ālī tar āmhī lagets tumchyā kholīt pāṭhvū.
lines.en: Don't worry. If the bag arrives, we'll send it straight to your room.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.native: धन्यवाद. आणि जर मला डॉक्टरची गरज पडली तर?
lines.roman: dhanyavād. āṇi dzar malā ḍôkṭarchī garadz paḍlī tar?
lines.en: Thank you. And what if I need a doctor?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.native: चोवीस तास डॉक्टर उपलब्ध आहेत. फक्त शून्य दाबा.
lines.roman: tsovīs tās ḍôkṭar upalabdha āhet. phakta shūnya dābā.
lines.en: There's a doctor available 24 hours. Just dial zero.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.native: हे आधी माहीत असतं तर मी इतकी काळजी केली नसती!
lines.roman: he ādhī māhīt astaṃ tar mī itkī kāḷjī kelī nastī!
lines.en: If I'd known this before, I wouldn't have worried so much!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.native: तुमची खोली तिसऱ्या मजल्यावर आहे. ही घ्या किल्ली.
lines.roman: tumchī kholī tisryā madzlyāvar āhe. hī ghyā killī.
lines.en: Your room is on the third floor. Here's the key.

culture: India's single emergency number is **112**; ambulance **108**, police **100**, fire **101**. In a crowd, shouting **'वाचवा!'** or **'चोर! चोर!'** will bring help fast. Mumbai's local trains have separate ladies' compartments (लेडीज डबा) and a general-public reputation for helping strangers. Railway staff and police in Maharashtra will usually speak Marathi and Hindi; making the effort in Marathi is often met with extra warmth.

tip.title: If… then: जर… तर…
tip.body:
- **जर** + condition, **तर** + result. The 'if' part uses the **past** form, even about the future: जर ट्रेन **चुकली** तर… 'if we miss the train…'.
- **जर** is often dropped; **तर** is enough: उशीर झाला तर फोन कर.
- **नाहीतर** 'otherwise': लवकर निघ, नाहीतर ट्रेन चुकेल.

sentences.roman: dzar ṭren tsuklī tar basne dzāū.
sentences.en: If we miss the train, we'll go by bus.

sentences.native: उशीर झाला तर मला फोन कर.

sentences.native: जर काही धोका असेल तर लगेच बाहेर या.

sentences.en: If there's any danger, come out right away.

sentences.native: इथे रात्री फिरणं सुरक्षित आहे का?
sentences.roman: ithe rātrī phirṇaṃ surakṣit āhe kā?

sentences.native: खोली स्वच्छ नसली तर तक्रार करा.
sentences.roman: kholī svachchha naslī tar takrār karā.
sentences.en: If the room isn't clean, make a complaint.
I complained to the hotel.

sentences.native: पैसे मिळाले नाहीत तर काय करायचं?
sentences.roman: paise miḷāle nāhīt tar kāy karāytsaṃ?

sentences.native: तुम्ही इथे सुरक्षित आहात, काळजी करू नका.
sentences.roman: tumhī ithe surakṣit āhāt, kāḷjī karū nakā.
sentences.en: You're safe here, don't worry.

sentences.native: जर तुला बरं वाटलं नाही तर मला सांग.
sentences.roman: dzar tulā baraṃ vāṭlaṃ nāhī tar malā sāṅg.
sentences.en: If you don't feel well, tell me.
If your luggage gets lost, make a complaint.

sentences.native: इथे अपघात झाला आहे, लवकर या!
sentences.roman: ithe apaghāt dzhālā āhe, lavkar yā!
sentences.en: There's been an accident here, come quickly!
A man is injured.
Call an ambulance right away.
Mum is in hospital.
Where's the police station?
He was injured in the accident.
I need a doctor right away.

tip.title: If only: …असतं तर
tip.body:
- For what didn't happen: past form + **असता / असती / असतं** = 'would have': मी **आलो असतो** 'I would have come'.
- Both halves use it: मला **माहीत असतं** तर मी **आलो असतो** 'if I'd known, I'd have come'.
- Negative: **नसता / नसती / नसतं**: ट्रेन चुकली **नसती**.

sentences.en: My phone has been stolen.

sentences.native: मी बॅग जवळ ठेवली असती तर चोरी झाली नसती.
sentences.roman: mī bæg dzavaḷ ṭhevlī astī tar tsorī dzhālī nastī.
sentences.en: If I'd kept my bag close, it wouldn't have been stolen.

sentences.native: मला माहीत असतं तर मी तुला फोन केला असता.
sentences.roman: malā māhīt astaṃ tar mī tulā fon kelā astā.
sentences.en: If I'd known, I'd have called you.
There's a fire in the kitchen!

sentences.native: पोलीस लवकर आले असते तर चोर सापडला असता.
sentences.roman: polīs lavkar āle aste tar tsor sāpaḍlā astā.
sentences.en: If the police had come sooner, they would have caught the thief.
If you lose your passport, go to the embassy.

sentences.native: पाकीट हरवलं नसतं तर आम्ही टॅक्सी घेतली असती.
sentences.roman: pākīṭ haravlaṃ nastaṃ tar āmhī ṭæksī ghetlī astī.
sentences.en: If the wallet hadn't been lost, we'd have taken a taxi.

sentences.native: छत्री घेतली असती तर भिजलो नसतो.
sentences.roman: chhatrī ghetlī astī tar bhidzlo nasto.
sentences.en: If I'd taken an umbrella, I wouldn't have got soaked. (man)

sentences.native: तू आला असतास तर बरं झालं असतं.
sentences.roman: tū ālā astās tar baraṃ dzhālaṃ astaṃ.
sentences.en: It would have been nice if you had come.
